name: pixel-studio
description: Create, edit, animate and export pixel art with Pixel Studio: PXA sprite files, rendering, image-to-pixel clean-up, palettes, walk/run templates and a live link to the open editor.

interface.shortDescription: Draw, animate and export pixel-art sprites
interface.longDescription: Create, edit, animate and export pixel art with Pixel Studio: PXA sprite files, rendering, image-to-pixel clean-up, palettes, walk/run templates and a live link to the open editor. Requires Node.js 20 or newer. Files stay in your workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use Pixel Studio to draw a 32×32 knight sprite and render it.
Use Pixel Studio to turn hero.png into clean pixel art with 16 colours.
Use Pixel Studio to add a walk cycle to my rigged character and export a sprite sheet.
